 🔴LIVE | First Alert Daily: Showers linger into your Saturday... 
 Tune in around 2 p.m. for an update 
 By Austin Lowe Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 1:51 PM EST | Updated : 17 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google TALLAHASSEE, Fla. (WCTV) - It has been a dreary week, and that continues to be the case through the rest of the day and into our Saturday. 
 The weather should improve for the back end of the weekend. Meteorologist breaks down what you need to know on First Alert Daily. 
 To stay updated on all the latest forecasts and weather, follow WCTV First Alert Weather on Facebook and X ( Twitter ) .
